milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the seagrass cluster (centered around spawn-relative x=2, y=0, z=7 in the water channel) and face toward it. Max distance of 5 allows detection from the shore before entering water, and 45° facing tolerance ensures the player is actually looking at the seagrass plants.

Uses position_inside_box because swimming is a movement/traversal task — the player must physically enter the deeper part of the water channel. The box covers z=7 to z=9 (avoiding the shallow edge at z=6) to ensure the player is actually submerged in the 2-block-deep water, not just touching the edge. The wide x-range (-3 to 18) and y-range (-1 to 1) accommodate any swimming path across the channel.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The diamond block is at spawn-relative (3, 0, 12) on the far stone shore. Max distance of 4 ensures the player has crossed the water channel and reached the far shore before triggering. The 45° facing tolerance confirms the player is looking at the diamond block, not just passing by.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The soul campfire is at spawn-relative (5, 0, 14) under a dark oak shelter. Max distance of 5 allows the player to observe it from a safe distance (soul campfires deal 2 damage/sec on contact), while the 45° facing tolerance ensures the player is actually looking at the campfire structure.
